statement: Every Hong Kong company must have a company secretary, who must ordinarily reside in Hong Kong if a natural person or have its registered office or a place of business in Hong Kong if a body corporate (Companies Ordinance section 474(1) and (4)); the first company secretary is the person named in the registered incorporation form, and the director of a private company having only one director must not also be its company secretary (section 475(2)).
caveat: A director of a multi-director company may double as secretary. Corporate secretaries operating as a business need a trust or company service provider licence under the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorist Financing Ordinance (Cap. 615), which this rule does not cover.
